path = programs / 'task-97fac849.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [row[left:right + 1] for row in grid[top:bottom + 1]]
    copies = sum(value == 4 for row in grid for value in row)
    return [row * copies for row in shape]
'''
